payload.reason: The evidence provides specific metrics and methods used to measure gender bias amplification in language generation models, including bias scores and the effectiveness of different architectures.

claims.text: The bias amplification metric is computed to study the effect of amplifying potential bias in text for different language generation models.
The bias score of a word is calculated considering its word embedding and two gender indicators, which helps identify amplification of gender bias.
The architecture introduced mitigates gender bias amplification by updating a memory module with an equal ratio across gender types.
